verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs explicitly describe an API-based approach to managing multiple locations and registering readers (via serial number, registration code, or order number), and require reader-to-location registration for payments—covering both halves of the story. Community evidence (stripe-terminal-comm-1) corroborates that full API-level integration for terminal/location management is a real, valued capability. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end code/agent example combining location creation + reader registration in one API workflow, and no direct evidence of an AI agent performing this specific provisioning flow (the MCP server exists but isn't shown driving Terminal fleet setup).
